metadata.short_desc: Register every tool, inject the manual on demand
metadata.desc: All tools are still registered with AstrBot, so upstream permissions (persona tool allow-lists, per-session plugin filtering, per-tool enable switches) keep applying. Before each request the plugin runs a local retrieval over the user's message and hands the model only the full schemas of the tools activated for that turn. It saves prompt budget and context window, not tool execution compute.

lazy-tools.title: Lazy Tools
lazy-tools.description: Inspect the tool registry and per-session activation state, and dry-run retrieval to calibrate thresholds
lazy-tools.heading: Lazy Tools
lazy-tools.subheading: Tools stay registered; manuals are injected on demand. Inspect the registry, per-session activation, and dry-run retrieval here.
lazy-tools.playground_hint: read-only, does not touch the activation table
